2609.04842.title: MMTClinic: Multimodal, Multilingual Time Series Question Answering and Reasoning Benchmark for Clinical Domain
2609.04842.paper_summary: Time-series data in clinical settings is crucial for capturing dynamic changes in a patient's health over time, enabling timely diagnosis, personalized treatment, and early detection of critical events. However, the development of clinically reliable and linguistically inclusive medical AI systems remains a significant challenge, primarily due to the lack of multimodal, multilingual, and time-series-grounded benchmarks that reflect the complexity of real-world clinical scenarios. To fill this gap, we present MMTClinic, a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models (LLMs) on complex reasoning and question-answering tasks involving clinical time-series. MMTClinic combines text, medical images, and multivariate physiological signals and includes 30,000 QA pairs (15,000 multiple choice questions (MCQs) and 15,000 open-ended questions) across five languages: English, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, and Tamil. These questions cover three important clinical tasks---mortality prediction, heart rate forecasting, and SOFA score estimation. We evaluate 13 state-of-the-art LLMs in zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought settings. Our evaluation reveals notable differences in model performance across tasks, languages, and modalities, highlighting current limitations in clinical reasoning capabilities. MMTClinic provides a valuable resource for advancing multilingual, multimodal, and time-series-aware medical AI research. The dataset will be made publicly available on successful acceptance of the work.
2609.04842.paper_summary_zh: 臨床環境中的時間序列數據對於捕捉患者健康隨時間的動態變化至關重要，能夠實現及時診斷、個性化治療和早期發現關鍵事件。<lb/>然而，開發臨床可靠且語言包容的醫療人工智慧系統仍然是一個重大挑戰，主要是因為缺乏反映現實臨床場景複雜性的多模態、多語言和基於時間序列的基準。<lb/>為填補這一空白，我們提出了MMTClinic，一個旨在評估大型語言模型（LLMs）在涉及臨床時間序列的複雜推理和問答任務上的基準。<lb/>MMTClinic結合了文本、醫學影像和多變量生理信號，並包含30,000對問答（15,000道選擇題和15,000道開放式問題），涵蓋五種語言：英語、印地語、孟加拉語、馬拉地語和泰米爾語。<lb/>這些問題涵蓋了三個重要的臨床任務——死亡率預測、心率預測和SOFA分數估算。<lb/>我們在零樣本、少樣本和思維鏈設定下評估了13個最先進的LLMs。<lb/>我們的評估顯示模型在任務、語言和模態之間的性能存在顯著差異，突顯了當前臨床推理能力的限制。<lb/>MMTClinic為推進多語言、多模態和時間序列感知的醫療人工智慧研究提供了寶貴的資源。<lb/>該數據集將在工作成功接受後公開提供。
